work.problem: F-0112, owner's option (a), 2026-11-17 12:21 CT: the projector treats an issue as journaled when an existing register row names it. Add an optional issue field (owner/repo#N) to findings_register.v2 rows, write it on every projected row, set F-0100's to #103, skip issues a row names, and run capa_project.py --check in journal.yml.

findings.reason: This is its correction and preventive action, the owner's option (a): rows name their issue, the projector skips an issue a row names, and journal.yml runs --check so a hand-written row with no issue link fails CI.
Its row gets issue Drecoder/Engineering_Excellence_Playbook#103, the link the hand-written entry carries only in prose. The ID stays F-0100.
A rule ships with its check (rule-without-control): --check goes into journal.yml in the same change, with a designed-to-fail test.
Same lesson: an unchecked field is a claim. The new issue field is validated by the schema's pattern, and the projector's skip set is tested.
rule-without-control again: the gate is part of the change, not a follow-up.
The projector must stay faithful: adding issue to projected rows must not change any entry text; the existing projection tests over real issues must still pass unchanged.
After the tests pass, mutate the skip logic and --check to see what the suite misses.
The work has its ticket (KAN-114) before it starts; F-0112's row already carries it.

Contract changes: issue is an optional field added to findings_register.v2, following the precedent of ticket (KAN-60 slice 4). An existing v2 document stays valid; only rows that use the field need the new schema.

Vendored contracts: consumers vendor schemas/ at a pin. An optional field added to v2 leaves every existing register valid, and no consumer writes this register, so no consumer's vendored copy is broken; noted in the PR.
builder.spec and the price table; untouched.
The control-catch metric; this change records no new detection, so the metric is unaffected.
Ranking and deadlines; no row's severity or due date changes.
The sync PR's source name; untouched.
Agent commits still author as the owner until KAN-69; the configured author is kept (F-0096).
Dependabot and the central CI; untouched.

lessons: Ship the projector's check in CI in the same change (F-0014, F-0030).
Name links in data, never parse them from prose (F-0112).
Mutate the new skip and check logic after the tests pass (F-0098).
uncertainty: The --check step needs the issue list from the API in CI; if journal.yml's token cannot read issues, the step must fail closed, not skip.
